Misbah-ul-Haq Criticizes Pakistan Cricket Board Post-Resignation

Former Pakistan head coach Misbah-ul-Haq has criticized the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) following his resignation. He stated that cosmetic changes would not fix the issues within Pakistan cricket. Misbah-ul-Haq expressed his views after stepping down from his coaching role, suggesting that superficial measures are insufficient to address the underlying problems in the sport.
